top_concerns: Baselines are U-Net methods on weaker backbones; no baseline ported to the same DiT, so the DiT-specific benefit is confounded with the backbone
Small, self-designed 56-prompt single-object evaluation judged by one detector (OWL-ViT); no multi-object cases, no variance; t_a/t_b tuned on the test set
RoPE-attention mechanism supported by a single qualitative attention visualization; no quantitative analysis, and no ablation of the R-token mask or the LLM prompt split (prompt enrichment confound)
3D-aware control via position density only shown qualitatively, with no quantitative evaluation
Some claims overstated: 'best across all metrics' is not supported by Table 1 (e.g., CogVideoX variant), and Tora is compared with point rather than box conditioning
